messages:
ravi_partnerships: heads-up — i've pushed a WIP repo for a lightweight terraform "refkit-lite" we can hand to marketplace partners (CloudAtlas first). want feedback on scope before we open to partners. repo: https://github.com/redwood/refkit-lite :spiral_note_pad:
megan_cloud: nice. what's the minimal deliverable here? starter module + sample app + marketplace packaging?
sam_infra: agree. also needs CI smoke tests that validate AMI/instance types across regions. can we keep matrix small? (x86 + arm64, linux only)
jonathan_eng: small matrix is safer. suggest: module that deploys 1x inference node + load-balancer + sample nginx proxy to exercise ports. include output metrics endpoint for smoke tests.
elena_pm: product ask — include a 'quickstart-note' that calls out billing/estimate + recommended sizes for dev vs prod. one-liners are enough.
ravi_partnerships: good list. i'll update README. also thinking of a lightweight terraform example of model-serving service block. 
nicole_docs: i can draft the quickstart note and marketplace blurb. will need screenshots of Console + marketplace listing copy.
sam_infra: for CI, propose a small GH actions workflow:
```
name: smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: init terraform
        run: terraform init
      - name: plan
        run: terraform plan -out=tfplan
      - name: apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve tfplan
      - name: run smoke
        run: curl -fsS $SMOKE_URL/health || exit 1
```
This keeps minutes low and fails fast.
deploy-bot: repository created: github.com/redwood/refkit-lite (public) by ravi_partnerships
jonathan_eng: do we need partner-specific variations (marketplace vs direct deploy)? maybe two example vars files: marketplace.tfvars and selfhost.tfvars. minimal diffs.
megan_cloud: yes — marketplace packaging requires some metadata files and a scripted build that outputs an OVA / cloud-specific artifact depending on vendor. for CloudAtlas we need a packaged AMI manifest.
ravi_partnerships: i can add a packaging script skeleton. but prefer we keep it optional in root 'packaging/' so partners opt in.
elena_pm: timeline? CloudAtlas expects a tech handoff in ~3 weeks, and a partner engineering review 1 week after that. can we target a v0.1 for internal review in 9 days?
sam_infra: 9 days is tight but doable if we scope to starter + CI + quickstart note. skip packaging v0.1.
nicole_docs: i'll prep the quickstart outline and the one-pager marketplace blurb in that timeframe.
jonathan_eng: also call out recommended instance families and golden AMI build steps in docs. avoids partner confusion.
megan_cloud: we should add a small telemetry opt-in in example to show request/latency numbers (no PII). that will help partners validate perf.
ravi_partnerships: agreed — add a tiny prometheus exporter stub in sample app.
megan_cloud: ping @sam_infra for infra review when draft PR is up.
sam_infra: will review. also annotate terraform with locked provider versions and example state backend config (s3 + encryption).
elena_pm: i'll schedule the CloudAtlas handoff meeting for 2 weeks out; invite list: partner-eng, partner-success, docs, infra.
nicole_docs: will add a 'notes-for-partner-review.md' with review checklist: details, security checklist, required tests, and known limitations (arm64 caveats, region availability).
ravi_partnerships: awesome. i'll open the initial PR today with README and sample variables. thanks all :thumbsup: 
jonathan_eng: small suggestion before PR — add a short snippet in README showing how to override model size/unit:
```
variable "instance_type" { default = "g5.xlarge" }
variable "replicas" { default = 1 }
```
megan_cloud: love that. after PR merge i'll copy the quickstart to our partner Portal and link to it in the marketplace listing draft.
sam_infra: final note — put a short 'rollback' example in docs for the sample app in case smoke fails (terraform destroy + alert). helps partners understand cleanup.
ravi_partnerships: noted. if no objections i'll push PR later today and tag reviewers.
megan_cloud: go for it 
deploy-bot: pull request opened: #12 by ravi_partnerships -> main (refkit-lite)
sam_infra: reviewing now 
nicole_docs: will start the docs draft and attach to PR
jonathan_eng: quick nit — add LICENSE (apache-2.0)
ravi_partnerships: added LICENSE in PR update
megan_cloud: thanks everyone — this feels like a clean, partner-friendly starter. we'll iterate after the CloudAtlas review. :rocket:
